requirement_statement: The simulation engine shall calculate multi-sector balance sheets across Central Bank Commercial Banks Corporate Households Government and Financial Markets where the sum of net financial assets across all sectors equals zero
expected_behavior: Balance sheet matrix maintains exact conservation where sum of net financial assets is zero
failure_behavior: Clamps diverging values and flags accounting imbalance in telemetry
rationale: Ensures mathematical integrity and prevents money leakage
acceptance_test: Assert sum of all sectoral net financial assets equals zero within numerical tolerance

requirement_statement: When the simulation clock advances one tick the simulation engine shall compute all inter-sector cash flows and update sectoral stock accumulations within 16 milliseconds
expected_behavior: All recursive differential equations update within one animation frame
failure_behavior: Skips frame render without dropping state update
data_and_state: Simulation tick counter and state vectors
acceptance_test: Measure execution time of 100 consecutive engine ticks using performance.now()

requirement_statement: The central bank module shall adjust the policy interest rate in response to simulated inflation gaps and output gaps using an empirical Taylor rule reaction function
expected_behavior: Policy rate shifts deterministically based on inflation and output deviations
failure_behavior: Limits rate to non-negative or specified floor
data_and_state: Policy interest rate inflation rate output gap
rationale: Reflects actual modern central bank monetary policy behavior
acceptance_test: Verify computed policy rate matches closed-form Taylor formula across inflation scenarios
metric: Taylor rule policy rate computation accuracy

requirement_statement: The commercial banking module shall create new deposit liabilities simultaneously with the creation of new loan assets when credit is extended to corporations or households
expected_behavior: Bank balance sheet expands equally on asset side and liability side
failure_behavior: Rejects loan origination if bank capital adequacy is violated
data_and_state: Bank reserves commercial loans customer deposits
acceptance_test: Verify loan creation increases both bank assets and deposits by identical amounts
target: Delta Loans == Delta Deposits at origination

requirement_statement: The corporate finance module shall calculate the discounted cash flow enterprise value and equity value of non-financial corporations using the dynamic weighted average cost of capital
preconditions: Corporate revenue and cost state available
expected_behavior: Enterprise value updates dynamically when cost of debt or equity changes
failure_behavior: Falls back to baseline valuation if cash flows become non-computable
data_and_state: Corporate cash flows WACC enterprise value equity value
rationale: Demonstrates direct transmission of interest rates into company valuation
acceptance_test: Compare computed enterprise value with DCF discount formula across multiple discount rates

requirement_statement: The household sector module shall determine aggregate consumption expenditures as a function of disposable labor income net asset wealth and debt service obligations
preconditions: Labor income and debt service parameters loaded
expected_behavior: Consumption updates continuously with wealth and disposable income shifts
failure_behavior: Prevents consumption from exceeding available liquid savings plus debt limits
data_and_state: Household income consumption savings debt service
rationale: Models the primary real economy demand engine
acceptance_test: Verify consumption changes proportionally to disposable income based on marginal propensity

requirement_statement: The fiscal policy module shall compute sovereign tax revenues government expenditures budget balances and Treasury bond issuances at each simulation period
preconditions: Tax rate and spending parameters set
expected_behavior: Budget deficit matches difference between expenditures and tax collections
failure_behavior: Deficit is funded by Treasury bond issuance
data_and_state: Tax receipts government outlays debt issuance
rationale: Illustrates sovereign fiscal policy mechanics and deficit debt dynamics
acceptance_test: Verify deficit equals outlays plus interest minus tax revenues

requirement_statement: The financial markets module shall compute the term structure of sovereign bond yields and reprice bond market values using analytical duration and convexity formulas
expected_behavior: 10-year bond price reprices following convexity curve with duration sensitivity
failure_behavior: Yield curve points remain monotonic or properly inverted without negative NaN yields
data_and_state: Yield curve points bond prices duration convexity
rationale: Demonstrates interest rate risk and bond repricing mechanics
acceptance_test: Validate 10Y bond repricing against analytical bond price formula when yield shifts from 4% to 5%

requirement_statement: The financial markets module shall maintain an active order book matching bid and ask limit orders to compute continuous market depth and clearing prices
expected_behavior: Order book matches overlapping bids and asks and executes trades at clearing price
failure_behavior: Unmatched orders remain in queue ordered by price-time priority
data_and_state: Bid queue ask queue last clearing price volume
rationale: Provides hands-on understanding of equity and bond market clearing
acceptance_test: Submit test buy and sell orders and verify clearing price matches theoretical auction midpoint

requirement_statement: When a user adjusts an interactive macroeconomic slider the system shall recompute all dependent sectoral states and re-render visual telemetry within 16 milliseconds without page reload
expected_behavior: All downstream financial indicators reprice instantly on the active canvas
failure_behavior: Restores previous valid value if input is invalid
acceptance_test: Simulate input change event on policy rate slider and measure DOM update time

requirement_statement: The simulation controls shall provide pre-configured historical shock scenarios including the 2008 Global Financial Crisis the 1970s Volcker Rate Hike and the 2020 Liquidity Injection
expected_behavior: Simulation parameters reconfigure to historical initial conditions instantly
failure_behavior: Reverts to default baseline if scenario configuration fails to parse
rationale: Grounds theoretical learning in recognizable historical crisis events
acceptance_test: Select each preset scenario and verify initial interest rate credit spread and reserve parameters match specification

requirement_statement: The visual telemetry module shall display animated SVG conduit streams with particle pulse velocity proportional to active monetary transaction volume between institutional sectors
expected_behavior: Conduits animate directional flow with pulse frequency reflecting transaction volume
failure_behavior: Fades to resting baseline line if transaction volume reaches zero
rationale: Provides intuitive visual mental models of liquidity flows
acceptance_test: Inspect rendered SVG elements and verify stroke-dashoffset or motion-path attributes update dynamically

requirement_statement: The user interface shall present all simulation controls charts and diagrams using a strict monochromatic broadsheet color palette adhering to light and dark theme tokens
expected_behavior: Visual styling utilizes exclusively shades of black white neutral gray and slate
failure_behavior: Enforces dark mode fallback if theme token is missing
data_and_state: CSS custom properties Tailwind color tokens
rationale: Maintains elegant Swiss broadsheet aesthetic without visual distraction
acceptance_test: Scan all computed CSS color properties in rendered DOM to ensure zero chromatic saturation

requirement_statement: The user interface components shall provide a minimum contrast ratio of 3 to 1 against adjacent background surfaces as specified by WCAG 2.2 Success Criterion 1.4.11
expected_behavior: Interactive controls borders and graph lines meet 3 to 1 contrast ratio
failure_behavior: Highlights active element with focus ring if contrast falls below threshold
rationale: Guarantees accessibility compliance for graphical controls
acceptance_test: Measure color contrast between slider tracks thumbs borders and backgrounds

requirement_statement: When interactive controls receive focus the interface shall support full keyboard operation and announce dynamic value changes through ARIA live regions
expected_behavior: Arrow keys increment or decrement values and screen reader announces changes
failure_behavior: Traps focus cleanly within dialogs if modal open
rationale: Ensures full accessibility for keyboard and screen-reader users
acceptance_test: Send ArrowUp and ArrowDown keyboard events and verify value updates and aria-valuenow reflects change
